steps.title: Boil water
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil.

steps.title: Cook pasta
steps.instruction: Cook spaghetti two minutes less than the packet says.

steps.title: Garlic oil
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, warm oil, garlic and chili gently until garlic turns pale gold.

steps.title: Save water
steps.instruction: Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss
steps.instruction: Toss pasta in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Stir in parsley, taste for salt and serve right away.
